notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.3.2 bundles Browser CRM V4.2. Want to Contact is now visually nested under Leads and uses the same Supabase-synced full CRM records as the main Leads view. Uncontacted CRM leads appear there automatically and use the same drawer, calls, messages, notes, status changes and follow-ups across Desktop and phone. Finder shortlist businesses that have not yet become full CRM leads are retained in a separate secondary section and deduplicated against full CRM leads. Existing Supabase two-way sync, SQLite mirror/cache, Twilio calling, messaging, Finder, call scripts, summaries and updater behaviour are preserved.
